informal_statement:
If \(\lambda>1\) and \(-1<z<1\), \(D\) is differentiable at \(z\), with
\[
D'(z)=z[1/\sqrt{1-z^2}-1/(\lambda\sqrt{\lambda^2-z^2})].
\]
reason: Source `CMVElementary.lean:187-203`: The exact derivative coefficient and its density factor agree, with differentiability asserted only at interior arguments.
